summary:
Project Summary – ECHOES OF SPACE

We developed ECHOES OF SPACE, an interactive digital archive that showcases the forgotten explorers of space, including historical spacecraft, rovers, landers, and scientific instruments.

The website allows users to explore space heritage through three major categories: The Moon, Mars, and Beyond Mars. It includes search functionality, category-based filters, interactive mission cards, and detailed information about each space object, including its mission overview, major achievements, and current status. We also integrated a Python FastAPI backend to manage mission data and support chatbot-based interactions.

Our project addresses the challenge of making historical space exploration information accessible, organized, and engaging. Instead of allowing the achievements of past missions to be forgotten, our platform brings their stories together in one place.

This project is important because it preserves humanity's space exploration heritage, promotes scientific awareness, and inspires students and future generations to explore space science and technology.
